free_tier.stated: Core service free; Member storage is unlimited hot storage, files deleted 30 days after no activity; 2048 Mb per file; 35 GB per day of traffic.
free_tier.notes: Guest traffic is 15 GB per day; Guest uploads are listed as 100 GB a day.

per_object_cap.stated: 2048 Mb per file for Guest and Member; 20480 Mb for Premium only
per_object_cap.notes: The plans table prints the unit as Mb and splits the cap by plan; Premium is 20480 Mb.

retention.stated: Forever. For premium users. Files are stored indefinitely. For free users, active files will be stored for 30 days, meaning there must be at least one download every 30 days.

egress.terms: Download and stream traffic is capped per day: 15 GB for Guest, 35 GB per day for Member (registered free), 100 GB per day for Premium.
egress.free_allowance: 35 GB per day (registered free); 15 GB per day (non-registered)

interface_detail: Upload via browser, FTP, remote URL, API and a Zoom uploader, as listed on the FAQ.
tooling: FTP, remote URL and API upload per the FAQ; the API page was not read.
chaining: 20 GB per file and FTP/API upload make it scriptable, but free files need a download every 30 days to stay.

limits.value: 2048 Mb per file (Guest and Member); 20480 Mb per file for Premium
free files deleted without a download in 30 days
35 GB per day for Member, 15 GB per day for Guest

binding_note: The 30-day inactivity deletion is the only number printed for the free tier.

identity_cost.detail: The register page asks for username, email, password, a repeated password and an hCaptcha; no phone or card field is on the form. Whether a Guest can upload without registering is unverified: the upload form was not exercised.

reliability_note: Premium plans (10 TB, 100 GB per day) are listed at USD 15.99 per month, USD 8 per month on the 12-month term.
confidence_note: FAQ, plans comparison, register and premium pages read on 2026-11-03. Whether Guest upload needs no account is unverified.
